lines.text: What if I told you that you could start making money online using AI, even if you have absolutely no coding or design experience?
Here are five AI tools that can help you turn your skills into a business.
First, ChatGPT. Use it to write content, research ideas, create marketing strategies, and help businesses with everyday tasks.
Second, Canva. Create professional social media designs, presentations, advertisements, and digital products that you can sell.
Third, CapCut. Offer short-form video editing services to businesses and content creators.
Fourth, Lovable. Build websites and simple applications using AI, even if you're not an experienced programmer.
And fifth, Zapier. Help businesses automate repetitive tasks, connect their apps, and save hours of manual work.
You don't need to master all five tools.
Pick one, learn how to use it, create a few examples, and start offering that service to businesses.
Instead of selling AI, you're selling a solution to a real problem.
AI isn't going to make you rich overnight, but learning how to use it could open doors to opportunities that didn't exist a few years ago.
